124.ar: أَبُو عَمرو الزُّبیرِی عَنْ أَبِی عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (علیه السلام) قَالَ قُلْتُ لَهُ أَیُّهَا الْعَالِمُ أَخْبِرْنِی أَیُّ الْأَعْمَالِ أَفْضَلُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ مَا لَا یَقْبَلُ اللَّهُ شَیْئاً إِلَّا بِهِ قُلْتُ وَ مَا هُوَ قَالَ الْإِیمَانُ بِاللَّهِ الَّذِی لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ أَعْلَی الْأَعْمَالِ دَرَجَةً وَ أَشْرَفُهَا مَنْزِلَةً وَ أَسْنَاهَا حَظّاً قَالَ قُلْتُ أَ لَا تُخْبِرُنِی عَنِ الْإِیمَانِ أَ قَوْلٌ هُوَ وَ عَمَلٌ أَمْ قَوْلٌ بِلَا عَمَلٍ فَقَالَ الْإِیمَانُ عَمَلٌ کُلُّهُ وَ الْقَوْلُ بَعْضُ ذَلِکَ الْعَمَلِ بِفَرْضٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ بَیَّنَ فِی کِتَابِهِ وَاضِحٍ نُورُهُ ثَابِتَةٍ حُجَّتُهُ یَشْهَدُ لَهُ بِهِ الْکِتَابُ وَ یَدْعُوهُ إِلَیْهِ قَالَ قُلْتُ صِفْهُ لِی جُعِلْتُ فِدَاکَ حَتَّی أَفْهَمَهُ قَالَ الْإِیمَانُ حَالَاتٌ وَ دَرَجَاتٌ وَ طَبَقَاتٌ وَ مَنَازِلُ فَمِنْهُ التَّامُّ الْمُنْتَهَی تَمَامُهُ وَ مِنْهُ النَّاقِصُ الْبَیِّنُ نُقْصَانُهُ وَ مِنْهُ الرَّاجِحُ الزَّائِدُ رُجْحَانُهُ قُلْتُ إِنَّ الْإِیمَانَ لَیَتِمُّ وَ یَنْقُصُ وَ یَزِیدُ قَالَ نَعَمْ قُلْتُ کَیْفَ ذَلِکَ قَالَ لِأَنَّ اللَّهَ تَبَارَکَ وَ تَعَالَی فَرَضَ الْإِیمَانَ عَلَی جَوَارِحِ ابْنِ آدَمَ (علیه السلام) وَ قَسَّمَهُ عَلَیْهَا وَ فَرَّقَهُ فِیهَا فَلَیْسَ مِنْ جَوَارِحِهِ جَارِحَةٌ إِلَّا وَ قَدْ وُکِّلَتْ مِنَ الْإِیمَانِ بِغَیْرِ مَا وُکِّلَتْ بِهِ أُخْتُهَا فَمِنْهَا قَلْبُهُ الَّذِی بِهِ یَعْقِلُ وَ یَفْقَهُ وَ یَفْهَمُ وَ هُوَ أَمِیرُ بَدَنِهِ الَّذِی لَا تَرِدُ الْجَوَارِحُ وَ لَا تَصْدُرُ إِلَّا عَنْ رَأْیِهِ وَ أَمْرِهِ وَ مِنْ-هَا عَیْنَاهُ اللَّتَانِ یُبْ-صِرُ بِهِمَا وَ أُذُنَاهُ اللَّتَانِ یَسْمَعُ بِهِمَا وَ یَدَاهُ اللَّتَانِ یَبْطِشُ بِهِمَا وَ رِجْلَاهُ اللَّتَانِ یَمْشِی بِهِمَا وَ فَرْجُهُ الَّذِی الْبَاهُ مِنْ قِبَلِهِ وَ لِسَانُهُ الَّذِی یَنْطِقُ بِهِ وَ رَأْسُهُ الَّذِی فِیهِ وَجْهُهُ فَلَیْسَ مِنْ هَذِهِ جَارِحَةٌ إِلَّا وَ قَدْ وُکِّلَتْ مِنَ الْإِیمَانِ بِغَیْرِ مَا وُکِّلَتْ بِهِ أُخْتُهَا بِفَرْضٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ تَبَارَکَ اسْمُهُ یَنْطِقُ بِهِ الْکِتَابُ لَهَا وَ یَشْهَدُ بِهِ عَلَیْهَا فَفَرَضَ عَلَی الْقَلْبِ غَیْرَ مَا فَرَضَ عَلَی السَّمْعِ وَ فَرَضَ عَلَی السَّمْعِ غَیْرَ مَا فَرَضَ عَلَی الْعَیْنَیْنِ وَ فَرَضَ عَلَی الْعَیْنَیْنِ غَیْرَ مَا فَرَضَ عَلَی اللِّسَانِ وَ فَرَضَ عَلَی اللِّسَانِ غَیْرَ مَا فَرَضَ عَلَی الْیَدَیْنِ وَ فَرَضَ عَلَی الْیَدَیْنِ غَیْرَ مَا فَرَضَ عَلَی الرِّجْلَیْنِ وَ فَرَضَ عَلَی الرِّجْلَیْنِ غَیْرَ مَا فَرَضَ عَلَی الْفَرْجِ وَ فَرَضَ عَلَی الْفَرْجِ غَیْرَ مَا فَرَضَ عَلَی الْوَجْهِ فَأَمَّا مَا فَرَضَ عَلَی الْقَلْبِ مِنَ الْإِیمَانِ فَالْإِقْرَارُ وَ الْمَعْرِفَةُ وَ الْعَقْدُ وَ الرِّضَا وَ التَّسْلِیمُ بِأَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِیکَ لَهُ إِلَهاً وَاحِداً لَمْ یَتَّخِذْ صَاحِبَةً وَ لَا وَلَداً وَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَ رَسُولُهُ وَ الْإِقْرَارُ بِمَا جَاءَ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ مِنْ نَبِیٍّ أَوْ کِتَابٍ فَذَلِکَ مَا فَرَضَ اللَّهُ عَلَی الْقَلْبِ مِنَ الْإِقْرَارِ وَ الْمَعْرِفَةِ وَ هُوَ عَمَلُهُ وَ هُوَ قَوْلُ اللَّهِ عَزَّوَجَلَّ إِلَّا مَنْ أُکْرِهَ وَ قَلْبُهُ مُطْمَئِنٌّ بِالْإِیمانِ وَ لکِنْ مَنْ شَرَحَ بِالْکُفْرِ صَدْراً وَ قَالَ أَلا بِذِکْرِ اللهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ وَ قَالَ الَّذِینَ آمَنُوا بِأَفْوَاهِهِمْ وَ لَمْ تُؤْمِنْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَ قَالَ إِنْ تُبْدُوا ما فِی أَنْفُسِکُمْ أَوْ تُخْفُوهُ یُحاسِبْکُمْ بِهِ اللهُ فَیَغْفِرُ لِمَنْ یَشاءُ وَ یُعَذِّبُ مَنْ یَشاءُ فَذَلِکَ مَا فَرَضَ اللَّهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ عَلَی الْقَلْبِ مِنَ الْإِقْرَارِ وَ الْمَعْرِفَةِ وَ هُوَ عَمَلُهُ وَ هُوَ رَأْسُ الْإِیمَانِ وَ فَرَضَ اللَّهُ عَلَی اللِّسَانِ الْقَوْلَ وَ التَّعْبِیرَ عَنِ الْقَلْبِ بِمَا عَقَدَ عَلَیْهِ وَ أَقَرَّ بِهِ قَالَ اللَّهُ تَبَارَکَ وَ تَعَالَی وَ قُولُوا لِلنَّاسِ حُسْناً وَ قَالَ وَ قُولُوا آمَنَّا بِالَّذِی أُنْزِلَ إِلَیْنا وَ أُنْزِلَ إِلَیْکُمْ وَ إِلهُنا وَ إِلهُکُمْ واحِدٌ وَ نَحْنُ لَهُ مُسْلِمُونَ فَهَذَا مَا فَرَضَ اللَّهُ عَلَی اللِّسَانِ وَ هُوَ عَمَلُهُ وَ فَرَضَ عَلَی السَّمْعِ أَنْ یَتَنَزَّهَ عَنِ الِاسْتِمَاعِ إِلَی مَا حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ وَ أَنْ یُعْرِضَ عَمَّا لَا یَحِلُّ لَهُ مِمَّا نَهَی اللَّهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ عَنْهُ وَ الْإِصْغَاءِ إِلَی مَا أَسْخَطَ اللَّهَ عَزَّوَجَلَّ فَقَالَ فِی ذَلِکَ وَ قَدْ نَزَّلَ عَلَیْکُمْ فِی الْکِتابِ أَنْ إِذا سَمِعْتُمْ آیاتِ اللهِ یُکْفَرُ بِها وَ یُسْتَهْزَأُ بِها فَلا تَقْعُدُوا مَعَهُمْ حَتَّی یَخُوضُوا فِی حَدِیثٍ غَیْرِهِ ثُمَّ اسْتَثْنَی اللَّهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ مَوْضِعَ النِّسْیَانِ فَقَالَ وَ إِمَّا یُنْسِیَنَّکَ الشَّیْطانُ فَلا تَقْعُدْ بَعْدَ الذِّکْری مَعَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِینَ وَ قَالَ فَبَ-شِّرْ عِبادِ الَّذِینَ یَسْتَمِعُونَ الْقَوْلَ فَیَتَّبِعُونَ أَحْسَنَهُ أُولئِکَ الَّذِینَ هَداهُمُ اللهُ وَ أُولئِکَ هُمْ أُولُوا الْأَلْبابِ وَ قَالَ عَزَّوَجَلَّ قَدْ أَفْلَحَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ، الَّذِینَ هُمْ فِی صَلاتِهِمْ خاشِعُونَ، وَ الَّذِینَ هُمْ عَنِ اللَّغْوِ مُعْ-رِضُونَ، وَ الَّذِینَ هُمْ لِلزَّکاةِ فاعِلُونَ وَ قَالَ وَ إِذا سَمِعُوا اللَّغْوَ أَعْرَضُوا عَنْهُ وَ قالُوا لَنا أَعْمالُنا وَ لَکُمْ أَعْمالُکُمْ وَ قَالَ وَ إِذا مَرُّوا بِاللَّغْوِ مَرُّوا کِراماً فَهَذَا مَا فَرَضَ اللَّهُ عَلَی السَّمْعِ مِنَ الْإِیمَانِ أَنْ لَا یُصْغِیَ إِلَی مَا لَا یَحِلُّ لَهُ وَ هُوَ عَمَلُهُ وَ هُوَ مِنَ الْإِیمَانِ وَ فَرَضَ عَلَی الْبَصَرِ أَنْ لَا یَنْظُرَ إِلَی مَا حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ عَلَیْهِ وَ أَنْ یُعْرِضَ عَمَّا نَهَی اللَّهُ عَنْهُ مِمَّا لَا یَحِلُّ لَهُ وَ هُوَ عَمَلُهُ وَ هُوَ مِنَ الْإِیمَانِ فَقَالَ تَبَارَکَ وَ تَعَالَی قُلْ لِلْمُؤْمِنِینَ یَغُضُّوا مِنْ أَبْصارِهِمْ وَ یَحْفَظُوا فُرُوجَهُمْ فَنَهَاهُمْ أَنْ یَنْظُرُوا إِلَی عَوْرَاتِهِمْ وَ أَنْ یَنْظُرَ الْمَرْءُ إِلَی فَرْجِ أَخِیهِ وَ یَحْفَظَ فَرْجَهُ أَنْ یُنْظَرَ إِلَیْهِ وَ قَالَ وَ قُلْ لِلْمُؤْمِناتِ یَغْضُضْنَ مِنْ أَبْصارِهِنَّ وَ یَحْفَظْنَ فُرُوجَهُنَ مِنْ أَنْ تَنْظُرَ إِحْدَاهُنَّ إِلَی فَرْجِ أُخْتِهَا وَ تَحْفَظَ فَرْجَهَا مِنْ أَنْ یُنْظَرَ إِلَیْهَا وَ قَالَ کُلُّ شَیْءٍ فِی الْقُرْآنِ مِنْ حِفْظِ الْفَرْجِ فَهُوَ مِنْ الزِّنَا إِلَّا هَذِهِ الْآیَةَ فَإِنَّهَا مِنَ النَّظَرِ ثُمَّ نَظَمَ مَا فَرَضَ عَلَی الْقَلْبِ وَ اللِّسَانِ وَ السَّمْعِ وَ الْبَصَرِ فِی آیَةٍ أُخْرَی فَقَالَ وَ ما کُنْتُمْ تَسْتَتِرُونَ أَنْ یَشْهَدَ عَلَیْکُمْ سَمْعُکُمْ وَ لا أَبْصارُکُمْ وَ لا جُلُودُکُمْ یَعْنِی بِالْجُلُودِ الْفُرُوجَ وَ الْأَفْخَاذَ وَ قَالَ وَ لا تَقْفُ ما لَیْسَ لَکَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ إِنَّ السَّمْعَ وَ الْبَصَرَ وَ الْفُؤادَ کُلُّ أُولئِکَ کانَ عَنْهُ مَسْؤُلًا فَهَذَا مَا فَرَضَ اللَّهُ عَلَی الْعَیْنَیْنِ مِنْ غَضِّ الْبَصَرِ عَمَّا حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ وَ هُوَ عَمَلُهُمَا وَ هُوَ مِنَ الْإِیمَانِ وَ فَرَضَ اللَّهُ عَلَی الْیَدَیْنِ أَنْ لَا یَبْطِشَ بِهِمَا إِلَی مَا حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ وَ أَنْ یَبْطِشَ بِهِمَا إِلَی مَا أَمَرَ اللَّهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ وَ فَرَضَ عَلَیْهِمَا مِنَ الصَّدَقَةِ وَ صِلَةِ الرَّحِمِ وَ الْجِهَادِ فِی سَبِیلِ اللَّهِ وَ الطَّهُورِ لِلصَّلَاةِ فَقَالَ یا أَیُّهَا الَّذِینَ آمَنُوا إِذا قُمْتُمْ إِلَی الصَّلاةِ فَاغْسِلُوا وُجُوهَکُمْ وَ أَیْدِیَکُمْ إِلَی الْمَرافِقِ وَ امْسَحُوا بِرُؤُسِکُمْ وَ أَرْجُلَکُمْ إِلَی الْکَعْبَیْنِ وَ قَالَ فَإِذا لَقِیتُمُ الَّذِینَ کَفَرُوا فَضَرْبَ الرِّقابِ حَتَّی إِذا أَثْخَنْتُمُوهُمْ فَشُدُّوا الْوَثاقَ فَإِمَّا مَنًّا بَعْدُ وَ إِمَّا فِداءً حَتَّی تَضَعَ الْحَرْبُ أَوْزارَها فَهَذَا مَا فَرَضَ اللَّهُ عَلَی الْیَدَیْنِ لِأَنَّ الضَّرْبَ مِنْ عِلَاجِهِمَا وَ فَرَضَ عَلَی الرِّجْلَیْنِ أَنْ لَا یَمْشِیَ بِهِمَا إِلَی شَیْءٍ مِنْ مَعَاصِی اللَّهِ وَ فَرَضَ عَلَیْهِمَا الْمَشْیَ إِلَی مَا یُرْضِی اللَّهَ عَزَّوَجَلَّ فَقَالَ وَ لا تَمْشِ فِی الْأَرْضِ مَرَحاً إِنَّکَ لَنْ تَخْرِقَ الْأَرْضَ وَ لَنْ تَبْلُغَ الْجِبالَ طُولًا وَ قَالَ وَ اقْصِدْ فِی مَشْیِکَ وَ اغْضُضْ مِنْ صَوْتِکَ إِنَّ أَنْکَرَ الْأَصْواتِ لَصَوْتُ الْحَمِیرِ وَ قَالَ فِیمَا شَهِدَتِ الْأَیْدِی وَ الْأَرْجُلُ عَلَی أَنْفُسِهِمَا وَ عَلَی أَرْبَابِهِمَا مِنْ تَضْیِیعِهِمَا لِمَا أَمَرَ اللَّهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ بِهِ وَ فَرَضَهُ عَلَیْهِمَا الْیَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلی أَفْواهِهِمْ وَ تُکَلِّمُنا أَیْدِیهِمْ وَ تَشْ-هَدُ أَرْجُلُهُمْ بِما کانُوا یَکْس-ِبُونَ فَهَذَا أَیْضاً مِمَّ-ا فَرَضَ اللَّهُ عَ-لَی الْیَ-دَیْنِ وَ عَلَی الرِّجْلَیْنِ وَ هُوَ عَمَلُهُمَا وَ هُوَ مِنَ الْإِیمَانِ وَ فَرَضَ عَلَی الْوَجْهِ السُّجُودَ لَهُ بِاللَّیْلِ وَ النَّهَارِ فِی مَوَاقِیتِ الصَّلَاةِ فَقَالَ یا أَیُّهَا الَّذِینَ آمَنُوا ارْکَعُوا وَ اسْجُدُوا وَ اعْبُدُوا رَبَّکُمْ وَ افْعَلُوا الْخَیْرَ لَعَلَّکُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ فَهَذِهِ فَرِیضَةٌ جَامِعَةٌ عَلَی الْوَجْهِ وَ الْیَدَیْنِ وَ الرِّجْلَیْنِ وَ قَالَ فِی مَوْضِعٍ آخَرَ وَ أَنَّ الْمَساجِدَ لِلهِ فَلا تَدْعُوا مَعَ اللهِ أَحَداً وَ قَالَ فِیمَا فَرَضَ عَلَی الْجَوَارِحِ مِنَ الطَّهُورِ وَ الصَّلَاةِ بِهَا وَ ذَلِکَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّوَجَلَّ لَمَّا صَرَفَ نَبِیَّهُ (صلی الله علیه و آله) إِلَی الْکَعْبَةِ عَنِ الْبَیْتِ الْمُقَدَّسِ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ وَ ما کانَ اللهُ لِیُضِیعَ إِیمانَکُمْ إِنَّ اللهَ بِالنَّاسِ لَرَؤُفٌ رَحِیمٌ فَسَمَّی الصَّلَاةَ إِیمَاناً فَمَنْ لَقِیَ اللَّهَ عَزَّوَجَلَّ حَافِظاً لِجَوَارِحِهِ مُوفِیاً کُلُّ جَارِحَةٍ مِنْ جَوَارِحِهِ مَا فَرَضَ اللَّهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ عَلَیْهَا لَقِیَ اللَّهَ عَزَّوَجَلَّ مُسْتَکْمِلًا لِإِیمَانِهِ وَ هُوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ وَ مَنْ خَانَ فِی شَیْءٍ مِنْهَا أَوْ تَعَدَّی مَا أَمَرَ اللَّهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ فِیهَا لَقِیَ اللَّهَ عَزَّوَجَلَّ نَاقِصَ الْإِیمَانِ قُلْتُ قَدْ فَهِمْتُ نُقْصَانَ الْإِیمَانِ وَ تَمَامَهُ فَمِنْ أَیْنَ جَاءَتْ زِیَادَتُهُ فَقَالَ قَوْلُ اللَّهِ عَزَّوَجَلَّ وَ إِذا ما أُنْزِلَتْ سُورَةٌ فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ یَقُولُ أَیُّکُمْ زادَتْهُ هذِهِ إِیماناً فَأَمَّا الَّذِینَ آمَنُوا فَزادَتْهُمْ إِیماناً وَ هُمْ یَسْتَبْشِرُونَ وَ أَمَّا الَّذِینَ فِی قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ فَزادَتْهُمْ رِجْساً إِلَی رِجْسِهِمْ وَ قَالَ نَحْنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَیْکَ نَبَأَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ إِنَّهُمْ فِتْیَةٌ آمَنُوا بِرَبِّهِمْ وَ زِدْناهُمْ هُدیً وَ لَوْ کَانَ کُلُّهُ وَاحِداً لَا زِیَادَةَ فِیهِ وَ لَا نُقْصَانَ لَمْ یَکُنْ لِأَحَدٍ مِنْهُمْ فَضْلٌ عَلَی الْآخَرِ وَ لَاسْتَوَتِ النِّعَمُ فِیهِ وَ لَاسْتَوَی النَّاسُ وَ بَطَلَ التَّفْضِیلُ وَ لَکِنْ بِتَمَامِ الْإِیمَانِ دَخَلَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الْجَنَّةَ وَ بِالزِّیَادَةِ فِی الْإِیمَانِ تَفَاضَلَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ بِالدَّرَجَاتِ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَ بِالنُّقْصَانِ دَخَلَ الْمُفَرِّطُونَ النَّارَ.
124.en: Abu Amr al-Zubayri reported from Abu Abd Allah (peace be upon him), who said: I said to him, "O Scholar, inform me which deeds are best in the sight of Allah?" He replied, "That without which Allah does not accept anything." I asked, "And what is that?" He said, "Faith in Allah, the One besides whom there is no god; it is the highest of deeds in degree, the most noble in station, and the most abundant in share." I said, "Will you not inform me about faith? Is it a statement and an action, or a statement without action?" He replied, "Faith is entirely action, and the statement is a part of that action, made obligatory by Allah, clarified in His Book, its light manifest, its proof established; the Book bears witness to it and calls toward it." I said, "Describe it to me, may I be made your ransom, so that I may understand it." He said, "Faith has states, degrees, strata, and stations. Some of it is complete, its perfection attained; some of it is deficient, its deficiency manifest; and some of it is superior, its superiority increased." I said, "So faith becomes complete, decreases, and increases?" He said, "Yes." I said, "How is that?" He said, "Because Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, made faith obligatory upon the limbs of the son of Adam (peace be upon him), divided it among them, and distributed it within them. There is no limb among his limbs but that it has been entrusted with a duty of faith different from that of its sister. Among them is his heart, by which he reasons, understands, and comprehends; it is the commander of his body, and the limbs do not act or refrain except by its opinion and command. Among them are his two eyes, by which he sees; his two ears, by which he hears; his two hands, by which he strikes; his two feet, by which he walks; his private part, from which his desire originates; his tongue, by which he speaks; and his head, in which his face is located. There is no limb among these but that it has been entrusted with a duty of faith different from that of its sister, by an obligation from Allah, Blessed be His Name, which the Book speaks of for it and bears witness to against it. Thus, He made obligatory upon the heart something other than what He made obligatory upon the hearing; He made obligatory upon the hearing something other than what He made obligatory upon the eyes; He made obligatory upon the eyes something other than what He made obligatory upon the tongue; He made obligatory upon the tongue something other than what He made obligatory upon the hands; He made obligatory upon the hands something other than what He made obligatory upon the feet; He made obligatory upon the feet something other than what He made obligatory upon the private part; and He made obligatory upon the private part something other than what He made obligatory upon the face. As for what He made obligatory upon the heart regarding faith, it is affirmation, knowledge, commitment, contentment, and submission that there is no god but Allah alone, having no partner, a single God who has taken neither a companion nor a child, and that Muhammad is His servant and messenger, and affirmation of every prophet or book that has come from Allah. This is what Allah made obligatory upon the heart of affirmation and knowledge, and it is its action. This is the word of Allah, the Almighty and Majestic: 'Except for one who is forced, while his heart is secure in faith' (16:106), and He said: 'Verily, in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest' (13:28), and He said: 'And of the people are some who say, "We believe in Allah," but they are not believers' (2:8), and He said: 'Whether you reveal what is in your hearts or conceal it, Allah will bring you to account for it. Then He will forgive whom He wills and punish whom He wills' (2:284). This is what Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, made obligatory upon the heart of affirmation and knowledge; it is its action and the head of faith. Allah made obligatory upon the tongue the speech and expression of what the heart has committed to and affirmed. Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, said: 'And speak to people good [words]' (2:83), and He said: 'And say, "We believe in that which has been revealed to us and revealed to you. And our God and your God is one; and we are Muslims [in submission] to Him"' (29:46). This is what Allah made obligatory upon the tongue, and it is its action. He made obligatory upon the hearing that it remain pure from listening to what Allah has forbidden, that it turn away from what is not lawful for it—that which Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, has forbidden—and from listening to what angers Allah, the Almighty and Majestic. He said regarding this: 'And it has already been revealed to you in the Book that when you hear the verses of Allah being denied and ridiculed, do not sit with them until they enter into another conversation' (4:140). Then Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, excepted the state of forgetfulness, saying: 'And if Satan should cause you to forget, then do not remain after the reminder with the wrongdoing people' (6:68). And He said: 'So give good tidings to My servants—those who listen to speech and follow the best of it. Those are the ones Allah has guided, and those are people of understanding' (39:17-18). And He said, the Almighty and Majestic: 'Certainly will the believers have succeeded: They who are during their prayer humbly submissive, and they who turn away from ill speech, and they who are observant of zakah' (23:1-4). And He said: 'And when they hear ill speech, they turn away from it and say, "For us are our deeds, and for you are your deeds"' (28:55). And He said: 'And when they pass by ill speech, they pass by with dignity' (25:72). This is what Allah made obligatory upon the hearing regarding faith: that it not listen to what is not lawful for it. This is its action, and it is part of faith. He made obligatory upon the sight that it not look at what Allah has forbidden it, and that it turn away from what Allah has forbidden of that which is not lawful for it. This is its action, and it is part of faith. He said, Blessed and Exalted is He: 'Tell the believing men to reduce [some] of their vision and guard their private parts' (24:30). He forbade them from looking at their private parts, and that a man should look at the private part of his brother, and that he should guard his private part from being looked at. And He said: 'And tell the believing women to reduce [some] of their vision and guard their private parts' (24:31), so that one of them does not look at the private part of her sister, and that she guard her private part from being looked at. He said: 'Everything in the Quran regarding guarding the private part refers to adultery, except for this verse, for it refers to looking.' Then He organized what He made obligatory upon the heart, tongue, hearing, and sight in another verse, saying: 'And you were not covering yourselves, lest your hearing, your sights, and your skins would testify against you' (41:22)—meaning by 'skins' the private parts and thighs. And He said: 'And do not pursue that of which you have no knowledge. Indeed, the hearing, the sight, and the heart—about all those [one] will be questioned' (17:36). This is what Allah made obligatory upon the eyes regarding lowering the gaze from what Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, has forbidden; it is their action, and it is part of faith. Allah made obligatory upon the hands that they not strike with them at what Allah has forbidden, and that they strike with them at what Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, has commanded. He made obligatory upon them charity, maintaining ties of kinship, striving in the way of Allah, and purification for prayer. He said: 'O you who have believed, when you rise to prayer, wash your faces and your forearms to the elbows and wipe over your heads and wash your feet to the ankles' (5:6). And He said: 'So when you meet those who disbelieve [in battle], strike [their] necks until, when you have inflicted slaughter upon them, then secure their bonds, and either [confer] favor afterwards or ransom [them] until the war lays down its burdens' (47:4). This is what Allah made obligatory upon the hands, because striking is an act of them. He made obligatory upon the feet that one not walk with them toward any of the acts of disobedience to Allah, and He made obligatory upon them walking toward what pleases Allah, the Almighty and Majestic. He said: 'And do not walk upon the earth exultantly. Indeed, you will never tear the earth [apart], and you will never reach the mountains in height' (17:37). And He said: 'And be moderate in your pace and lower your voice; indeed, the most disagreeable of sounds is the voice of donkeys' (31:19). And He said regarding what the hands and feet testify to against themselves and their owners for their wasting what Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, commanded and made obligatory upon them: 'This Day, We seal over their mouths, and their hands speak to Us, and their feet testify about what they used to earn' (36:65). This is also from what Allah made obligatory upon the hands and the feet; it is their action, and it is part of faith. He made obligatory upon the face prostration to Him by night and day during the times of prayer. He said: 'O you who have believed, bow and prostrate and worship your Lord and do good—that you may succeed' (22:77). This is an obligation binding upon the face, the hands, and the feet. He said in another place: 'And [He revealed] that the masjids are for Allah, so do not invoke with Allah anyone' (72:18). And He said regarding what He made obligatory upon the limbs of purification and prayer with them: that when Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, turned His Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) toward the Kaaba away from the Holy House (Jerusalem), Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, revealed: 'And never would Allah have caused your faith to be lost. Indeed Allah is, to the people, Kind and Merciful' (2:143). Thus, He named prayer 'faith.' So whoever meets Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, having guarded his limbs, fulfilling for every limb of his limbs what Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, made obligatory upon it, meets Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, with his faith complete, and he is of the people of Paradise. And whoever betrays any of them or transgresses what Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, has commanded regarding them, meets Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, with deficient faith." I said, "I have understood the deficiency and perfection of faith, so from where does its increase come?" He said, "The word of Allah, the Almighty and Majestic: 'And whenever a surah is revealed, there are among them those who say, "Which of you has this increased in faith?" As for those who believed, it has increased them in faith, while they are rejoicing. But as for those in whose hearts is disease, it has increased them in evil [in addition] to their evil' (9:124-125). And He said: 'Indeed, it is they who were youths who believed in their Lord, and We increased them in guidance' (18:13). If it were all one, with no increase or decrease in it, no one would have any merit over another, the blessings would be equal, the people would be equal, and superiority would be void. But by the perfection of faith, the believers enter Paradise; by the increase in faith, the believers are ranked in degrees before Allah; and by the deficiency, the negligent enter the Fire."
124.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 394
124.refs: al-Kafi, Vol. 2, p. 36; al-Burhan; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 66, p. 27; al-Ayyashi, Vol. 2, p. 323; Nur al-Thaqalayn

124.ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) مَنْ لَقِیَ اللَّهَ کَامِلَ الْإِیمَانِ کَانَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ وَ مَنْ کَانَ مُضَیِّعاً لِشَیْءٍ مِمَّا افْتَرَضَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَی عَلَی هَذِهِ الْجَوَارِحِ وَ تَعَدَّی مَا أَمَرَ اللَّهُ بِهِ وَ ارْتَکَبَ مَا نَهَی عَنْهُ لَقِیَ اللَّهَ تَعَالَی نَاقِصَ الْإِیمَانِ وَ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ وَ إِذا ما أُنْزِلَتْ سُورَةٌ فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ یَقُولُ أَیُّکُمْ زادَتْهُ هذِهِ إِیماناً فَأَمَّا الَّذِینَ آمَنُوا فَزادَتْهُمْ إِیماناً وَ هُمْ یَسْتَبْشِرُونَ ... وَ لَوْ کَانَ الْإِیمَانُ کُلُّهُ وَاحِداً لَا زِیَادَةَ فِیهِ وَ لَا نُقْصَانَ لَمْ یَکُنْ لِأَحَدٍ فَضْلٌ عَلَی أَحَدٍ وَ لَتَسَاوَی النَّاسُ فِی تَمَامِ الْإِیمَانِ وَ بِکَمَالِهِ دَخَلَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الْجَنَّةَ وَ نَالُوا الدَّرَجَاتِ فِیهَا وَ بِذَهَابِهِ وَ نُقْصَانِهِ دَخَلَ آخَرُونَ النَّارَ.
124.fa: هرکس خدا را با ایمان کامل ملاقات کند از اهل بهشت است و هرکس چیزی از واجبات الهی را که بر این اعضا واجب شده ضایع و تباه کند و از دستور خدا سرپیچی کند و مرتکب منهیّات او شود، با ایمان ناقص خدا را ملاقات خواهد کرد. خدای عزّوجلّ می‌فرماید: وَ إِذا ما أُنْزِلَتْ سُورَةٌ فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ یَقُولُ أَیُّکُمْ زادَتْهُ هذِهِ ایماناً فَأَمَّا الَّذِینَ أمنوا فَزادَتْهُمْ ایماناً وَ هُمْ یَسْتَبْشِرُونَ ... که اگر تمام ایمان‌ها یکی بود و زیادی و کمی نداشت، هیچ‌کس بر دیگری برتری نداشت و همه‌ی مردم مساوی بودند. همانا به‌وسیله‌ی تام و کامل‌بودن ایمان است که مؤمنان وارد بهشت می‌شوند و در آن به درجات متفاوت دست می‌یابند و با نبودن ایمان و کاستی آن است که گروهی دیگر وارد جنّهم می‌شوند.
124.en: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: "Whoever meets Allah with complete faith shall be among the people of Paradise. And whoever neglects any of what Allah the Exalted has made obligatory upon these limbs, transgresses what Allah has commanded, and commits what He has forbidden, shall meet Allah the Exalted with deficient faith." Allah the Mighty and Majestic says: "And whenever a surah is revealed, there are some among them who say, 'Which of you has this increased in faith?' As for those who believe, it has increased them in faith, while they rejoice..." (9:124). If faith were entirely uniform, with no increase or decrease, no one would have superiority over another, and all people would be equal in the perfection of faith. It is through the perfection and completeness of faith that the believers enter Paradise and attain degrees therein, and it is through its absence and deficiency that others enter the Fire.
124.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 400
124.refs: Mustadrak al-Wasa'il, Vol. 11, p. 148; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 90, p. 53; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 66, p. 78

124.ar: قَالَ اللَّهُ وَ إِذَا تُلِیَتْ عَلَیْهِمْ آیَاتُهُ زَادَتْهُمْ إِیمَاناً. لِیَزْدَادُوا إِیمَاناً مَعَ إِیمَانِهِمْ. وَ یَزْدَادَ الَّذِینَ آمَنُوا إِیمَاناً. وَ مَا زَادَهُمْ إِلَّا إِیمَاناً وَ تَسْلِیماً. فَأَمَّا الَّذِینَ آمَنُوا فَزَادَتْهُمْ إِیمَاناً. وَ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قُلْنَا: یَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ الْإِیمَانَ یَزِیدُ وَ یَنْقُصُ؟ قَالَ: نَعَمْ یَزِیدُ حَتَّی یُدْخِلَ صَاحِبَهُ الْجَنَّةَ وَ یَنْقُصُ حَتَّی یُدْخِلَ صَاحِبَهُ النَّارَ.
124.en: God said: "And when His verses are recited to them, it increases them in faith." (Al-Anfal/2). "That they may add faith to their faith." (Al-Fath/4). "And that those who believe may increase in faith." (Al-Muddaththir/31). "And it did not increase them except in faith and submission." (Al-Ahzab/22). "As for those who believed, it increased them in faith." It is narrated from Ibn Umar that we said: "O Messenger of God! Does faith increase and decrease?" He said: "Yes, it increases until it brings its possessor into Paradise, and it decreases until it brings its possessor into the Fire."
124.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 402

124.ar: إِنَّ الْإِیمَانَ یَبْدُو لُمْظَةً فِی الْقَلْبِ کُلَّمَا ازْدَادَ الْإِیمَانُ ازْدَادَتِ اللُّمْظَة.
124.fa: ایمان مانند یک نقطه‌ی سفید در قلب ظاهر می‌شود، هرچه بر ایمان افزوده شود سفیدی هم زیاد می‌گردد.
124.en: Faith appears as a white spot in the heart; as faith increases, the whiteness also increases.
124.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 402

125.ar: عَن یُوسُف بنِ ثَابِتٍ عَن أَبِی عَبدِاللهِ (علیه السلام) قَالَ: لَا یَضُرُّ مَعَ الْإِیمَانِ عَمَلٌ وَ لَا یَنْفَعُ مَعَ الْکُفْرِ عَمَلٌ ثُمَّ قَالَ أَ لَا تَرَی أَنَّهُ قَالَ تَبَارَکَ وَ تَعَالَی وَ ما مَنَعَهُمْ أَنْ تُقْبَلَ مِنْهُمْ نَفَقاتُهُمْ إِلَّا أَنَّهُمْ کَفَرُوا بِاللهِ وَ بِرَسُولِهِ ... وَ ماتُوا وَ هُمْ کافِرُونَ.
125.fa: یوسف‌بن‌ثابت از امام صادق (علیه السلام) نقل کرده است که فرمود: «هیچ عملی به مؤمن زیان نمی‌رساند و هیچ کاری برای کافر سودی ندارد». آنگاه فرمود: «مگر مشاهده نمی‌کنی که خداوند فرمود: وَ ما مَنَعَهُمْ أَنْ تُقْبَلَ مِنْهُمْ نَفَقاتُهُمْ إِلَّا أَنَّهُمْ کَفَرُوا بِاللهِ وَ بِرَسُولِهِ. وَ ماتُوا وَ هُمْ کافِرُونَ.
125.en: Yusuf ibn Thabit narrated from Abu Abd Allah (peace be upon him) who said: "No deed causes harm alongside faith, and no deed is of benefit alongside disbelief." Then he said: "Do you not see that He, Blessed and Exalted is He, said: 'And nothing prevents their expenditures from being accepted from them except that they disbelieved in Allah and in His Messenger... and died while they were disbelievers.'"
125.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 402
125.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 65, p. 103 / al-Mahasin, Vol. 1, p. 166

125.ar: فَأَمَّا الرَّدُّ عَلَی مَنْ أَنْکَرَ زِیَادَةَ الْکُفْرِ فَمِنْ ذَلِکَ قَوْلُ اللَّهِ عَزَّوَجَلَّ فِی کِتَابِهِ إِنَّمَا النَّسِیءُ زِیادَةٌ فِی الْکُفْرِ وَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَی وَ أَمَّا الَّذِینَ فِی قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ فَزادَتْهُمْ رِجْساً إِلَی رِجْسِهِمْ وَ ماتُوا وَ هُمْ کافِرُونَ.
125.en: As for the refutation of those who deny the increase of disbelief, it is found in the words of Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, in His Book: "The postponing (of the sacred months) is only an addition in disbelief" (Tawbah/ 37), and His saying, the Exalted: "But as for those in whose hearts is a disease, it only added filth to their filth, and they died while they were disbelievers."
125.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 402
125.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 69, p. 103; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 90, p. 61

125.ar: فَکُلُّ عَمَلٍ مِنْ أَعْمَالِ الْخَیْرِ یَجْرِی عَلَی غَیْرِ أَیْدِی أَهْلِ الِاصْطِفَاءِ وَ عُهُودِهِمْ وَ حُدُودِهِمْ وَ شَرَائِعِهِمْ وَ سُنَّتِهِمْ وَ مَعَالِمِ دِینِهِمْ مَرْدُودٌ غَیْرُ مَقْبُولٍ وَ أَهْلُهُ بِمَحَلِّ کُفْرٍ وَ إِنْ شَمِلَتْهُمْ صِفَةُ الْإِیمَانِ أَ لَمْ تَسْمَعْ إِلَی قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَی وَ ما مَنَعَهُمْ أَنْ تُقْبَلَ مِنْهُمْ نَفَقاتُهُمْ إِلَّا أَنَّهُمْ کَفَرُوا بِاللهِ وَ بِرَسُولِهِ وَ ماتُوا وَ هُمْ کافِرُونَ فَمَنْ لَمْ یَهْتَدِ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْإِیمَانِ إِلَی سَبِیلِ النَّجَاةِ لَمْ یُغْنِ عَنْهُ إِیمَانُهُ بِاللَّهِ مَعَ دَفْعِهِ حَقَّ أَوْلِیَائِهِ وَ حَبِطَ عَمَلُهُ وَ هُوَ فِی الْآخِرَةِ مِنَ الْخاسِرِین.
125.en: Every good deed that is performed outside the hands of the chosen ones, their covenants, their boundaries, their laws, their traditions, and the landmarks of their religion is rejected and unacceptable. Its doer is in a state of disbelief, even if the attribute of faith encompasses them. Have you not heard the saying of Allah the Exalted: "And nothing prevents their expenditures from being accepted from them but that they disbelieved in Allah and in His Messenger and died while they were disbelievers"? Therefore, whoever among the people of faith is not guided to the path of salvation, their faith in Allah will not avail them while they reject the right of His representatives (Awliya), and their deeds will be rendered void, and in the Hereafter, they will be among the losers.
125.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 402

125.ar: وَ أَمَّا الَّذِینَ فِی قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ فَزادَتْهُمْ رِجْساً إِلَی رِجْسِهِمْ یَقُولُ شَکّاً إِلَی شَکِّهِمْ.
125.fa: وَ أَمَّا الَّذِینَ فِی قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ فَزَادَتْهُمْ رِجْساً إِلَی رِجْسِهِمْ، خداوند می‌فرماید: «شکّی بر شکّ ایشان».
125.en: "And as for those in whose hearts is a disease, it has added filth to their filth," he says: "doubt upon their doubt."
125.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 402
125.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 69, p. 126; Nur al-Thaqalayn; Al-Burhan; Al-Ayyashi, Vol. 2, p. 118

126.ar: رَوَی النّعمَانِی فِی تَفسِیرِهِ فِیمَا رَوَاهُ عَن أَمِیرِ المُؤْمِنِینَ (علیه السلام) أَنَّهُمْ سَأَلُوهُ عَنِ الْمُتَشَابِهِ فِی تَفْسِیرِ الْفِتْنَةِ فَقَالَ ... وَ مِنْهُ فِتْنَةُ الْمَرَضِ وَ هُوَ قَوْلُهُ سُبْحَانَهُ أَ وَ لایَرَوْنَ أَنَّهُمْ یُفْتَنُونَ فِی کُلِّ عامٍ مَرَّةً أَوْ مَرَّتَیْنِ ثُمَّ لا یَتُوبُونَ وَ لا هُمْ یَذَّکَّرُونَ أَیْ یَمْرَضُونَ وَ یُقْتَلُونَ.
126.fa: از امام علی (علیه السلام) درباره‌ی متشابه در تفسیر فتنه پرسیدند. فرمود: «... و معنای دیگر آن، بیماری است؛ مانند این سخن خداوند سبحان: أَ وَ لا یَرَوْنَ أَنَّهُمْ یُفْتَنُونَ فِی کُلِّ عامٍ مَرَّةً أَوْ مَرَّتَیْنِ ثُمَّ لا یَتُوبُونَ وَ لا هُمْ یَذَّکَّرُونَ؛ یعنی بیمار میشوند و کشته میشوند».
126.en: Al-Nu'mani narrated in his Tafsir, in what he narrated from Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him), that they asked him about the ambiguous (mutashabih) regarding the interpretation of 'fitnah' (trial/tribulation). He said: "...And among its meanings is the fitnah of illness, and it is His statement, Glorified be He: 'Do they not see that they are tried (yuftanun) once or twice every year? Yet they do not repent, nor do they remember,' meaning they fall ill and are killed."
126.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 404
126.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 5, p. 174 / Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 90, p. 16

126.ar: أَ وَ لَا یَرَوْنَ أَنَّهُمْ یُفْتَنُونَ فِی کُلِ عَامٍ مَرَّةً أَوْ مَرَّتَیْنِ قَالَ: أَیْ یَمْرَضُونَ ثُمَّ لَا یَتُوبُونَ وَ لَا هُمْ یَذَّکَّرُونَ.
126.fa: اوّلاَ یَرَوْنَ أَنَّهُمْ یُفْتَنُونَ فِی کُلِّ عَامٍ مَّرَّةً أَوْ مَرَّتَیْنِ؛ یعنی بیمار می‌شوند.
126.en: "Do they not see that they are tested every year once or twice?" He said: Meaning they fall ill, yet they do not repent, nor do they take heed.
126.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 404

127.ar: قَوْلُهُ نَظَرَ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلی بَعْضٍ یَعْنِی الْمُنَافِقِینَ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفُوا أَیْ تَفَرَّقُوا صَرَفَ اللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ عَنِ الْحَقِّ إِلَی الْبَاطِلِ بِاخْتِیَارِهِمُ الْبَاطِلَ عَلَی الْحَقِّ.
127.fa: نَظَرَ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلی بَعْضٍ؛ یعنی منافقین. ثُمَّ انْصَرَفُوا؛ یعنی متفرّق می‌شوند. صَرَفَ اللهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ؛ خدا دل‌هایشان را از حق برمی‌گرداند و باطل را بر حق ترجیح می‌دهند.
127.en: "They look at one another" means the hypocrites. "Then they turn away" means they disperse. "Allah has turned their hearts away" from the truth toward falsehood, because they chose falsehood over the truth.
127.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 404
127.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 9, p. 212/ Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 17, p. 204/ Al-Qummi, Vol. 1, p. 308

128.ar: عَنْ ثَعلَبَة عَن أَبِی عَبدِ اللهِ (علیه السلام) قَالَ: قَالَ اللَّهُ تَبَارَکَ وَ تَعَالَی لَقَدْ جاءَکُمْ رَسُولٌ مِنْ أَنْفُسِکُمْ قَالَ فِینَا عَزِیزٌ عَلَیْهِ ما عَنِتُّمْ قَالَ فِینَا حَرِیصٌ عَلَیْکُمْ قَالَ فِینَا بِالْمُؤْمِنِینَ رَؤُفٌ رَحِیمٌ قَالَ شَرِکْنَا الْمُؤْمِنِینَ فِی هَذِهِ الرَّابِعَةِ وَ ثَلَاثَةٌ لَنَا.
128.fa: ثعلبه از امام صادق (علیه السلام) نقل می‌کند: «خدای تبارک‌وتعالی فرمود: لَقَدْ جَاءکُمْ رَسُولٌ مِّنْ أَنفُسِکُمْ؛ خطاب به ماست، عَزِیزٌ عَلَیْهِ مَا عَنِتُّمْ؛ این هم درباره‌ی ماست؛ حَرِیصٌ عَلَیْکُم درباره‌ی ماست، بِالْمؤْمِنِینَ رَؤُوفٌ رَّحِیمٌ، در این قسمت چهارم، مؤمنین با ما شریک شده‌اند. آن سه قسمت اوّل اختصاص به ما دارد».
128.en: From Tha'labah, from Abu 'Abd Allah (peace be upon him), who said: Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, said: "There has certainly come to you a Messenger from among yourselves" — he said: This is regarding us. "It is grievous to him that you suffer" — he said: This is regarding us. "He is concerned for you" — he said: This is regarding us. "To the believers he is kind and merciful" — he said: We have shared the believers in this fourth [attribute], while the [first] three are for us.
128.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 404
128.refs: Al-Burhan / Nur al-Thaqalayn / Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 24, p. 329 / Al-'Ayyashi, Vol. 2, p. 118

128.ar: عَنْ عَبْدِاللهِ بْنِ سُلَیْمْانَ عَنْ أَبِی جَعْفَرٍ (علیه السلام) قَالَ تَلَا هَذِهِ الْآیَةَ لَقَدْ جاءَکُمْ رَسُولٌ مِنْ أَنْفُسِکُمْ قَالَ مِنْ أَنْفُسِنَا قَالَ عَزِیزٌ عَلَیْهِ ما عَنِتُّمْ قَالَ مَا عَنِتْنَا قَالَ حَرِیصٌ عَلَیْکُمْ عَلَیْنَا بِالْمُؤْمِنِینَ رَؤُفٌ رَحِیمٌ قَالَ بِشِیعَتِنَا رَءُوفٌ رَحِیمٌ فَلَنَا ثَلَاثَةُ أَرْبَاعِهَا وَ لِشِیعَتِنَا رُبُعُهَا.
128.fa: عبدالله‌بن‌سلیمان از امام باقر (علیه السلام) نقل می‌کند که فرمود: لَقَدْ جَاءکُمْ رَسُولٌ مِّنْ أَنفُسِکُمْ از ما است، عَزِیزٌ عَلَیْهِ ما عَنِتُّمْ؛ آنچه ما را میرنجاند. حَرِیصٌ عَلَیْکُمْ؛ یعنی بر ما، بِالْمُؤْمِنِینَ رَؤُفٌ رَحِیمٌ؛ به شیعیان ما رئوف و مهربان است. سه قسمت برای ما است و یک چهارم برای شیعیان ماست.
128.en: Abdullah ibn Sulayman narrates from Abu Ja’far (peace be upon him) that he recited this verse: "There has certainly come to you a Messenger from among yourselves" (9:128). He said: "From among us." He said: "Grievous to him is what you suffer" (9:128). He said: "What we suffer." He said: "Concerned over you" (9:128). He said: "Concerned over us." "To the believers is kind and merciful" (9:128). He said: "Kind and merciful to our Shia." Thus, three-quarters of it belongs to us, and one-quarter of it belongs to our Shia.
128.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 404
128.refs: al-Burhan / Nur al-Thaqalayn / al-Ayyashi, Vol. 2, p. 118 / Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 24, p. 329 / Mishkat al-Anwar, p. 95

128.ar: فَمَنَّ اللَّهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ عَلَیْکُمْ بِمُحَمَّدٍ (صلی الله علیه و آله) فَبَعَثَهُ إِلَیْکُمْ رَسُولًا مِنْ أَنْفُسِکُمْ وَ قَال لَقَدْ جاءَکُمْ رَسُولٌ مِنْ أَنْفُسِکُمْ عَزِیزٌ عَلَیْهِ ما عَنِتُّمْ حَرِیصٌ عَلَیْکُمْ بِالْمُؤْمِنِینَ رَؤُفٌ رَحِیمٌ وَ قَالَ لَقَدْ مَنَّ اللهُ عَلَی الْمُؤْمِنِینَ إِذْ بَعَثَ فِیهِمْ رَسُولًا مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ ... فَکَانَ الرَّسُولُ (صلی الله علیه و آله) إِلَیْکُمْ مِنْ أَنْفُسِکُمْ بِلِسَانِکُمْ فَعَلَّمَکُمُ الْکِتَابَ وَ الْحِکْمَةَ.
128.fa: پس خداوند بر شما لطف کرد و محمّد (صلی الله علیه و آله) را رسولی از میان خودتان به‌سوی شما فرستاد و در آنچه که از کتابش فرو فرستاد فرمود: لَقَدْ جاءَکُمْ رَسُولٌ مِنْ أَنْفُسِکُمْ عَزِیزٌ عَلَیْهِ ما عَنِتُّمْ حَرِیصٌ عَلَیْکُمْ بِالمُؤْمِنِینَ رَؤُفٌ رَحِیمٌ و فرمود: «خداوند بر مؤمنان منّت نهاد (نعمت بزرگی بخشید) هنگامی‌که در میان آن‌ها، پیامبری از جنس خودشان برانگیخت». رسول فرستاده‌شده به‌سوی شما، از خود شما بود و کتاب، حکمت، فرائض و سنّت را به شما آموخت.
128.en: Thus, Allah (Mighty and Majestic is He) bestowed favor upon you through Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) by sending him to you as a Messenger from among yourselves. He said: "There has certainly come to you a Messenger from among yourselves. Grievous to him is what you suffer; [he is] concerned over you and to the believers is kind and merciful." And He said: "Allah has certainly conferred [His] favor upon the believers when He sent among them a Messenger from themselves..." Thus, the Messenger (peace be upon him and his family) who was sent to you was from among yourselves, speaking your language, and he taught you the Book and the Wisdom.
128.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 406
128.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 33, p. 566; Al-Gharat, Vol. 1, p. 199

128.ar: لَقَدْ جَاءَکُمْ رَسُولٌ مِنْ أَنْفُسِکُمْ قِیلَ: مَعْنَاهُ أَنَّهُ مِنْ نِکَاحٍ لَمْ یُصِبْهُ شَیْءٌ مِنْ وِلَادَةِ الْجَاهِلِیَّةِ.
128.fa: لَقَدْ جاءَکُمْ رَسُولٌ مِنْ أَنْفُسِکُمْ، یعنی از نکاحی که از شیوه ولادتهای جاهلی به دور بوده است.
128.en: "There has certainly come to you a Messenger from among yourselves" (9:128). It is said: Its meaning is that he was from a marriage that was not touched by any of the practices of the births of the Age of Ignorance (Jahiliyyah).
128.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 406

128.ar: مِنْ أَنْفُسِکُمْ أَیْ مِنْ أَشْرَفِکُمْ وَ أَفْضَلِکُمْ.
128.fa: مِنْ أَنْفُسِکُمْ؛ یعنی از شریف‌ترین و بافضیلت‌ترین شما.
128.en: "From among yourselves," meaning from the most noble and most virtuous of you.
128.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 406
128.refs: Nur al-Thaqalayn / Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 87, p. 88 / Nur al-Thaqalayn / Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 16, p. 301

128.ar: عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ (رحمة الله علیه) فَقَالَ النَّبِیُّ (صلی الله علیه و آله) لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَلَام ... ثُمَّ وَصَفَنِیَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَی بِالرَّأْفَةِ وَ الرَّحْمَةِ وَ ذَکَرَ فِی کِتَابِهِ لَقَدْ جاءَکُمْ رَسُولٌ مِنْ أَنْفُسِکُمْ عَزِیزٌ عَلَیْهِ ما عَنِتُّمْ حَرِیصٌ عَلَیْکُمْ بِالْمُؤْمِنِینَ رَؤُفٌ رَحِیم.
128.fa: ابن‌عبّاس (رحمة الله علیه) گوید، پیامبر (صلی الله علیه و آله) به عبدالله‌بن‌سلام فرمود: «... خداوند مرا به رأفت و رحمت می‌ستاید و در قرآن می‌فرماید: لَقَدْ جاءَکُمْ رَسُولٌ مِنْ أَنْفُسِکُمْ عَزِیزٌ عَلَیْهِ ما عَنِتُّمْ حَرِیصٌ عَلَیْکُمْ بِالمُؤْمِنِینَ رَؤُفٌ رَحِیم».
128.en: Ibn Abbas (may God have mercy on him) said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said to Abdullah ibn Salam: "...Then God Almighty described me with compassion and mercy, and mentioned in His Book: 'There has certainly come to you a Messenger from among yourselves. Grievous to him is what you suffer; [he is] concerned over you and to the believers is kind and merciful.'"
128.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 406
128.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 9, p. 291; Nur al-Thaqalayn; al-Ihtijaj, Vol. 1, p. 49

128.ar: بِالْإِسْنَادِ یَرْفَعُهُ إِلَی الْإِمَامِ مُوسَی بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ (علیه السلام) قَالَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِی أَبِی جَعْفَرٌ عَنْ أَبِیهِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِی أَبِی عَلِیٌّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِی أَبِی الْحُسَیْنُ بْنُ عَلِیِّ بْنِ أَبِی طَالِبٍ (علیه السلام) قَالَ ... کَانَ یَقُولُ (صلی الله علیه و آله) حُبِّی خَالَطَ دِمَاءَ أُمَّتِی فَهُمْ یُؤْثِرُونِّی عَلَی الْآبَاءِ وَ عَلَی الْأُمَّهَاتِ وَ عَلَی أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَ لَقَدْ کَانَ أَقْرَبَ النَّاسِ وَ أَرْأَفَهُمْ فَقَالَ تَبَارَکَ وَ تَعَالَی لَقَدْ جاءَکُمْ رَسُولٌ مِنْ أَنْفُسِکُمْ عَزِیزٌ عَلَیْهِ ما عَنِتُّمْ حَرِیصٌ عَلَیْکُمْ بِالْمُؤْمِنِینَ رَؤُفٌ رَحِیمٌ.
128.fa: از امام علی (علیه السلام) روایت است: پیامبر (صلی الله علیه و آله) فرمود: «حُبّ من با خون امّتم درآمیخته و آنان مرا بر پدران و مادران و خودشان ترجیح میدهند». حضرت برای مردم مهربان‌ترین و دلسوزترین بود، خداوند تبارک‌وتعالی فرمود: لَقَدْ جاءَکُمْ رَسُولٌ مِنْ أَنْفُسِکُمْ عَزِیزٌ عَلَیْهِ ما عَنِتُّمْ حَرِیصٌ عَلَیْکُمْ بِالْمؤْمِنِینَ رَؤُفٌ رَحِیمٌ.
128.en: With a chain of narration reaching Imam Musa ibn Ja’far (peace be upon him), he said: My father Ja’far narrated to me, from his father, who said: My father Ali narrated to me, who said: My father al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) narrated to me, saying: He (peace be upon him and his family) used to say: "My love has mingled with the blood of my Ummah, such that they prefer me over their fathers, their mothers, and their own selves." He was indeed the closest of people and the most compassionate among them. Thus, the Blessed and Exalted said: "There has certainly come to you a Messenger from among yourselves. Grievous to him is what you suffer; [he is] concerned over you and to the believers is kind and merciful."
128.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 406
128.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 16, p. 341 / Irshad al-Qulub, Vol. 2, p. 406

129.ar: فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا یَا مُحَمَّدُ (صلی الله علیه و آله) عَمَّا تَدْعُوهُمْ إلَیْهِ فَقُلْ حَسْبِیَ اللهُ لا إِلهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَیْهِ تَوَکَّلْتُ وَ هُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِیمِ.
129.fa: فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا ای محمّد! اگر آن‌ها از آنچه که ایشان را به آن می‌خوانی، روی‌برگردانند، فَقُلْ حَسْبِیَ اللهُ لا إِلهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَیْهِ تَوَکَّلْتُ وَ هُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِیمِ.
129.en: "If they turn away, O Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), from that which you call them to, then say: 'Allah is sufficient for me; there is no god but He. On Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne.'"
129.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 406

129.ar: عَنْ حَنَانِ بْنِ سَدِیرٍ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ أَبَاعَبْدِ اللَّهِ (علیه السلام) عَنِ الْعَرْشِ وَ الْکُرْسِیِّ فَقَالَ إِنَّ لِلْعَرْشِ صِفَاتٍ کَثِیرَةً مُخْتَلِفَةً لَهُ فِی کُلِّ سَبَبِ وَضْعٍ فِی الْقُرْآنِ صِفَةٌ عَلَی حِدَةٍ فَقَوْلُهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِیمِ ... ثُمَّ الْعَرْشُ فِی الْوَصْلِ مُتَفَرِّدٌ مِنَ الْکُرْسِیِّ لِأَنَّهُمَا بَابَانِ مِنْ أَکْبَرِ أَبْوَابِ الْغُیُوبِ وَ هُمَا جَمِیعاً غَیْبَانِ وَ هُمَا فِی الْغَیْبِ مَقْرُونَانِ لِأَنَّ الْکُرْسِیَّ هُوَ الْبَابُ الظَّاهِرُ مِنَ الْغَیْبِ الَّذِی مِنْهُ مَطْلَعُ الْبِدَعِ وَ مِنْهُ الْأَشْیَاءُ کُلُّهَا وَ الْعَرْشُ هُوَ الْبَابُ الْبَاطِنُ الَّذِی یُوجَدُ فِیهِ عِلْمُ الْکَیْفِ وَ الْکَوْنِ وَ الْقَدْرِ وَ الْحَدِّ وَ الْأَیْنِ وَ الْمَشِیَّةِ وَ صِفَةِ الْإِرَادَةِ وَ عِلْمُ الْأَلْفَاظِ وَ الْحَرَکَاتِ وَ التَّرْکِ وَ عِلْمُ الْعَوْدِ وَ الْبَدْءِ فَهُمَا فِی الْعِلْمِ بَابَانِ مَقْرُونَانِ لِأَنَّ مُلْکَ الْعَرْشِ سِوَی مُلْکِ الْکُرْسِیِّ وَ عِلْمَهُ أَغْیَبُ مِنْ عِلْمِ الْکُرْسِیِّ فَمِنْ ذَلِکَ قَالَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِیمِ أَیْ صِفَتُهُ أَعْظَمُ مِنْ صِفَةِ الْکُرْسِیِّ وَ هُمَا فِی ذَلِکَ مَقْرُونَانِ قُلْتُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاکَ فَلِمَ صَارَ فِی الْفَضْلِ جَارَ الْکُرْسِیِّ قَالَ إِنَّهُ صَارَ جَارَهُ لِأَنَّ عِلْمَ الْکَیْفُوفِیَّةِ فِیهِ وَ فِیهِ الظَّاهِرُ مِنْ أَبْوَابِ الْبَدَاءِ وَ أَیْنِیَّتِهَا وَ حَدِّ رَتْقِهَا وَ فَتْقِهَافَهَذَانِ جَارَانِ أَحَدُهُمَا حَمَلَ صَاحِبَهُ فِی الصَّرْفِ وَ بِمَثَلٍ صَرَّفَ الْعُلَمَاءُ و یستدلوا {لِیَسْتَدِلُّوا} عَلَی صِدْقِ دَعْوَاهُمَا لِأَنَّهُ یَخْتَصُّ بِرَحْمَتِهِ مَنْ یَشاءُ وَ هُوَ الْقَوِیُّ الْعَزِیزُ.
129.en: Hanan ibn Sadir said: I asked Abu Abd Allah (peace be upon him) about the Throne (Arsh) and the Footstool (Kursi). He said: "The Throne has many different attributes; for every context in which it is mentioned in the Quran, it has a distinct attribute. Thus, His saying 'Lord of the Great Throne' [refers to the Great Dominion]... The Throne, in conjunction, is distinct from the Footstool, for they are two of the greatest gates of the Unseen. Both are unseen, and in the Unseen, they are paired together. The Footstool is the manifest gate of the Unseen, from which the emergence of all originated things and all things themselves proceed. The Throne is the hidden gate in which is found the knowledge of 'how' (kayf), 'being' (kawn), 'measure' (qadr), 'limit' (hadd), 'where' (ayn), 'will' (mashiyyah), the attribute of 'intent' (iradah), the knowledge of words and movements, the 'leaving' (tark), and the knowledge of the return and the beginning. They are two paired gates in knowledge, for the dominion of the Throne is different from the dominion of the Footstool, and its knowledge is more hidden than the knowledge of the Footstool. It is for this reason that He said 'Lord of the Great Throne,' meaning its attribute is greater than the attribute of the Footstool, yet they are paired in that state." I said: "May I be made your ransom, why then has it become, in excellence, the neighbor of the Footstool?" He replied: "It became its neighbor because the knowledge of 'how-ness' (kayfufiyyah) is within it, as is the manifest aspect of the gates of origination (bada'), its 'where-ness' (ayn), and the limit of its binding and loosening. Thus, these two are neighbors; one of them bears the other in the 'sarf' (morphology/transformation), and just as scholars use [morphology] to deduce the truth of their claims, [the Throne and Footstool] deduce the truth of their claims, for 'He singles out for His mercy whom He wills, and He is the Powerful, the Exalted.'"
129.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 408

129.ar: انَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّوَجَلَّ خَلَقَ الْعَرْشَ أَرْبَاعاً لَمْ یَخْلُقْ قَبْلَهُ الَّا ثَلَاثَةُ أَشْیَاءَ الْهَوَاءِ وَ الْقَلَمِ وَ النُّورَ ثُمَّ خَلْقِهِ مِنْ أَنْوَارٍ مُخْتَلِفَةٍ فَمِنْ ذَلِکَ النُّورُ نُورُ اخْضَرَّ اخْضَرَّتْ مِنْهُ الْخُضْرَةُ وَ نُورِ اصْفَرَّ اصْفَرَّتْ مِنْهُ الصُّفْرَةُ وَ نُورٍ احمراحمرت مِنْهُ الْحُمْرَةُ وَ نُورِ ابْیَضَّ وَ هُوَ نُورٍ الانوار وَ مِنْهُ ضَوْءُ النَّهَارِ ثُمَّ جَعَلَهُ سَبْعِینَ أَلْفَ طَبَقٍ: غِلَظُ کُلِّ طَبَقُ کاول الْعَرْشِ الی أَسْفَلَ السافلین لَیْسَ مِنْ ذَلِکَ طَبَقُ الَّا یُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدِ رَبَّهُ وَ یُقَدِّسُهُ باصوات مُخْتَلِفَةٍ وَ السُّنَّةِ غَیْرِ مُشْتَبِهَةً وَ لَوْ أَذَّنَّ لِلِّسَانِ مِنْهَا فَاسْمَعْ شَیْئاً مِمَّا تَحْتَهُ لِهَدْمِ الْجِبَالِ وَ الْمَدَائِنِ وَ الْحُصُونِ وَ لَخَسَفَ الْبِحَارِ وَ لَا هَلَکَ مَا دُونَهُ لَهُ ثَمَانِیَةَ أَرْکَانِ عَلَیَّ کُلِّ رُکْنٍ مِنْهَا مِنَ الْمَلَائِکَةُ مَا لَا یُحْصِی عَدَدَهُمْ الاالله عَزَّوَجَلَّ یُسَبِّحُونَ اللَّیْلَ وَ النَّهارَ لا یَفْتُرونَ وَ لَوْ حِسُّ شَیْءٍ مِمَّا فَوْقَهُ مَا قَامَ لِذَلِکَ طَرْفَةَ عَیْنٍ بَیْنَهُ وَ بَیْنَ الاحساس الْجَبَرُوتِ وَ الْکِبْرِیَاءِ وَ الْعَظَمَةِ وَ الْقُدُسِ وَ الرَّحْمَةِ وَ الْعِلْمِ وَ لَیْسَ وَرَاءَ هَذَا مَقَالٍ.
129.en: Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, created the Throne (al-Arsh) as the fourth thing; He did not create anything before it except three things: the air, the Pen, and the Light. Then He created it from various lights: from that light, there is the green light, from which greenness originated; the yellow light, from which yellowness originated; the red light, from which redness originated; and the white light, which is the Light of lights, and from it is the brightness of the day. Then He made it seventy thousand layers; the thickness of each layer is like the distance from the Throne to the lowest of the low (asfal al-safilin). There is no layer among them that does not glorify its Lord with praise and sanctify Him with different voices and distinct manners that do not resemble one another. If permission were granted for one of them to be heard by what is beneath it, it would demolish the mountains, the cities, and the fortresses, cause the seas to sink, and destroy everything beneath it. It has eight pillars, and upon each pillar are angels whose number none knows except Allah, the Almighty and Majestic; they glorify Him night and day and do not falter. If anything from above it were perceived, nothing could withstand it for the blinking of an eye. Between it and perception lie the Might (Jabarut), the Grandeur (Kibriya), the Greatness (Azama), the Holiness (Quds), the Mercy (Rahma), and the Knowledge (Ilm), and beyond this, there is no further discourse.
129.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 408

129.ar: عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ الْفَضْلِ عَنِ الرِّضَا (علیه السلام) عَنْ أَبِیهِ (علیه السلام) قَالَ: ... قَالَ جَعْفَرٌ (علیه السلام) نَعَمْ یَا رَبِیعُ لَمَّا رَأَیْتُ الشَّرَّ فِی وَجْهِهِ قُلْتُ حَسْبِیَ الرَّبُّ مِنَ الْمَرْبُوبِینَ وَ حَسْبِیَ الْخَالِقُ مِنَ الْمَخْلُوقِینَ وَ حَسْبِیَ الرَّازِقُ مِنَ الْمَرْزُوقِینَ وَ حَسْبِیَ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِینَ حَسْبِی مَنْ هُوَ حَسْبِی حَسْبِی مَنْ لَمْ یَزَلْ حَسْبِی حَسْبِیَ اللهُ لا إِلهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَیْهِ تَوَکَّلْتُ وَ هُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِیمِ.
129.fa: حسن‌بن‌فضل از امام رضا (علیه السلام) نقل کرد که فرمود: ... امام صادق (علیه السلام) [به ربیع] فرمود: «ای ربیع! هنگامی که شرّ را در چهره او (منصور دوانیقی) دیدم، گفتم: «پروردگار مرا در برابر مخلوقات، کافی است و آفریدگارم مرا در برابر آفریدگان کفایت میکند و روزی‌دهنده مرا از روزی خورندگان کفایت میکند و خداوند که پروردگار جهانیان است برایم کافی است. کافی است او که کفایت میکند، کافی است کسی که هنوز مرا کفایت میکند، خداوند مرا کفایت می‌کند، هیچ معبودی جز او نیست، بر او توکّل کردم و او پروردگار عرش عظیم است».
129.en: Al-Hasan ibn al-Fadl narrated from al-Rida (peace be upon him), from his father (peace be upon him), who said: ... Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: "Yes, O Rabi'. When I saw the evil in his [al-Mansur al-Dawaniqi's] face, I said: 'The Lord is sufficient for me against the created; the Creator is sufficient for me against the creatures; the Provider is sufficient for me against those who are provided for; and Allah, the Lord of the worlds, is sufficient for me. Sufficient for me is He who is my sufficiency; sufficient for me is He who has always been my sufficiency; Allah is sufficient for me; there is no god but He; upon Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the Tremendous Throne.'"
129.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 410
